Flow.description: Assigns ownership on every new Lead. Checks first whether Salesforce flagged the Lead as a duplicate of an existing Lead and, if so, gives it to that Lead's owner. Otherwise, builds a pool of eligible teammates based on the schools the family is interested in (or, if none were selected, the district their zip code falls in, with a borough-level fallback), narrows that pool to language-matching teammates when the family's preferred language isn't English and at least one teammate speaks it, and assigns the Lead to the teammate in that pool who has gone longest without a new Lead — while keeping every teammate's open caseload within a reasonable range of the rest of the team. If no eligible teammate can be found, the Lead goes to the Outreach & Enrollment queue and a task is created flagging it for manual assignment. Email_Only queue
